'''Chris Terwilliger''' (Players Committee forum name Chris Twigg) is a core member of [[Team Albany]]. He played in 2025 Players Committee constructed events and reached the Top 8 of the [[2014 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-2025">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025/ 2025 Morristown Melee], starwarsccg.org</ref>

[[File:Chris Terwilliger DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Chris Terwilliger at [[DecipherCon 2000]] after [[Team Albany]] won the Star Wars CCG team championship]]

At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he won Sunday's four-player team championship with [[Matt Sokol]], [[Jonny Chu]], and [[Brian Terwilliger]].<ref name="eltwigg">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Brian Terwilliger], X (14 November 2020)</ref>
